component.name: NkMail
component.summary: A native email client for multiple accounts
支持多个账号的原生邮件客户端

description.p: Read and search email, manage attachments, and compose messages with durable local drafts. Supports IMAP, POP3 and SMTP with application passwords and secure credential storage.
阅读与搜索邮件、管理附件，并使用持久化本地草稿撰写邮件。支持 IMAP、POP3、SMTP、应用专用密码和安全凭据存储。
